name: Large-dataset spatial ST_DWithin with R-tree row-group prune
claim: 1 M POINTs in a single 16-row-group Parquet file; ST_DWithin with ~1 % selectivity. Indexed (GIST + R-tree row-group prune) wall-clock must be at least 100× faster than the unindexed scan, and must return the identical row count (Haversine UDF re-checks).
